messages:
maria: proposing a compact SDK + REST header convention so clients can hint region/tier and opt into routing debug traces without requiring immediate console changes
kevin: like it. can you propose exact header names and semantics?
jess: mobile SDKs prefer param-friendly surface rather than raw headers; SDK options should translate 1:1 to headers
maria: proposed headers: X-Redwood-Region-Hint, X-Redwood-Tier-Override, X-Redwood-Routing-Mode (strict|best-effort), X-Redwood-Routing-Debug
samir: toss over a curl + SDK example so we have concrete plumbing?
maria: example curl:
```bash
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Region-Hint: eu-west-1' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Tier-Override: platinum' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Routing-Mode: best-effort' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Routing-Debug: route,reason' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-vanilla-7b"}'
```
JS SDK sugar: client.generate({model: 'redwood-vanilla-7b', routing: {regionHint: 'eu-west-1', tierOverride: 'platinum', mode: 'best-effort', debug: ['route','reason']}})
li: define priority: explicit SDK/header > project region setting > customer default region > auto-routing. If requested region/tier unavailable, runtime should fallback unless routing.mode==strict
jess: compliance customers will want strict enforced. we should support a per-customer flag to force strict behavior and surface it in console
samir: propose fallback ordering: 1) same model family & variant in region, 2) closest quantization/variant available in region, 3) nearest region within latency SLO, 4) lower-cost variant with telemetry tagging
maria: agreed. telemetry keys to emit: routing.hint.region, routing.override.tier, routing.mode, routing.fallback.reason, routing.fallback.variant, routing.latency.estimated_ms, routing.rollout.bucket, routing.rollout.version
ops-telemetry: noted. we will add structured spans and request-log fields and bake dashboards for fallback rate, variant distribution, and cross-pool spillover
console-ux: UX asks: per-customer routing insights page (region distribution, fallback %, requests by variant), a soft toggle to flip routing.mode for a customer, and controls to pin strict for compliance customers
jess: quotas: if fallback routes to a different capacity pool, billing still charges the customer but console should show per-pool usage and pool-level quota exhaustion alerts
li: debug behavior: when X-Redwood-Routing-Debug includes 'route' reply with a short single-line response header 'x-redwood-routing-trace' summarizing chosen route and reason; full debug logs only allowed for admin keys and explicit opt-in
kevin: impl notes: runtime consults policy store (capacity matrix, entitlements, region latency map). keep the header surface minimal, SDK maps 1:1. add unit/integration tests for fallback ordering and strict-mode enforcement
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag 'routing-sdk-headers' targeted canary=10% staging traffic
samir: will add tests for edge cases and telemetry emission; also add a feature flag to gate strict enforcement per-customer
console-ux: additional ask: a per-route heatmap showing variant fallbacks over time and an alert when fallback rate > 1% for > 10m
maria: action items: samir write tests, ops-telemetry add fields, console-ux wireframe, infra add policy-store hooks, kevin coordinate rollout plan. I'll draft RFC today
kevin: thanks; please leave comments on the RFC by EOD.
